tier_reason: The product's actual customer-facing embed. Not a wrapper -- this is the surface Chatwoot/Intercom-style comparisons are against, so it stays fully invested regardless of the react/angular call.
verification_method: Read widget/src/*.ts. Different shape from the other 6 -- it is not an auth/chat client library, it is a pre-built embeddable UI over its own realtime layer.

auth.note: Uses the visitor/non-credentialed hub handshake (fixed in PR #46 / repo history #4,#6,#7), not the account auth flow -- widgets never log a customer's own agents in. Not a gap; a different flow.

widgets.note: N/A -- the widget IS the widget instance, it doesn't manage other widgets.

realtime.protocol: own visitor-token realtime layer, see widget/src/realtime.ts

rag.note: N/A from the visitor side -- RAG is an agent/admin-side retrieval concern.

webhooks.note: N/A -- no customer-facing outbound webhook API exists yet.

notes: This package's capability shape is deliberately different from the client SDKs -- it is measured against the platform's public/visitor-facing surface, not the authenticated agent-facing surface the other 6 packages target.
